description: This source file defines interfaces and configurations for a storage subsystem in a software project. It includes the StorageProvider and CacheProvider interfaces, various configuration structs for different storage backends (local, PostgreSQL, vector database), and a factory method to create storage instances based on environment variables and configuration. The code manages different storage modes, initializes relevant storage backends, and provides mechanisms for external file and method references.

classes.name: ComponentDIDRequest
classes.description: Represents a component Decentralized Identifier (DID) request with associated metadata.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the vector storage feature is enabled based on the configuration.

methods.name: normalized
methods.description: Returns a normalized version of the vector storage configuration with default values set.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Factory method that creates and initializes a storage backend and cache provider based on configuration and environment variables.
